text.en: The monument honors former president Corazon Aquino.
It was unveiled on December 9, 2011 during the opening of the Batang Pinoy National Championships in Naga.
Jesse Robredo and Education Secretary Armin Luistro attended the opening ceremonies that included the unveiling.
